name: Cadenza Arthouse Media Tools
_note: The studio's own tools, as a character aboard the station (owner, log 20260912-02). Character design comes later; for now it is the real Cadenza Arthouse logo stamped on a big floating coin, rendered from F:\Apps\Libraries\assets\logo.png by tools/camt_coin.py (96 px; the 09-12 coin was a blank plate because the logo's white background was stamped as ink - he noticed 2026-11-06), never hand-drawn. Bump ?v= on the image path after a rerender: the edge caches the file. Its lines are placeholders too. What it is NOT yet: a live model. That is the 'AI models as NPCs' idea in CAMT FUTURE_IDEAS, and the Metal Gear codec-style call the owner described is recorded there as well.
